title: TraceEvent
description: One append-only event in a run's trace. Single 'type' enum (the v1 kind/type split is reconciled to 'type'). seq is gap-free PER run_id, owned by a single writer per run; runs are stitched into a lineage by origin_session_id + parent_span. This is both the observability stream and the audit trail.

run_id.description: The run this event belongs to (a research session, a backtest, or a paper-live deployment).

seq.description: Monotonic, gap-free sequence within run_id. Used as SSE Last-Event-ID for replay-from-seq.

origin_session_id.description: Stitches the research -> propose -> backtest -> paper lineage across independently-writing services.

span_id.description: Span this event belongs to (e.g. a single tool call).

data.description: Type-specific payload (tool name + args, result summary + provenance, reasoning text, transition from/to, fill details, etc.). Validated per-type downstream.

EventType.description: denial = a refused action (e.g. risk gate rejection); keepalive = SSE heartbeat so idle proxies don't kill the stream (the v1 idle-kill lesson).
